name: helpie-audio-bridge
description: Native macOS ScreenCaptureKit audio capture bridge for Electron/Node.

scripts.build:arm64: npx node-gyp rebuild --arch=arm64 --release && mkdir -p bin/arm64 && cp build/Release/audio_capture.node bin/arm64/audio_capture_arm64.node && codesign --force --sign - bin/arm64/audio_capture_arm64.node
scripts.test: mkdir -p build && clang++ -std=c++17 -I. tests/ring_buffer_test.cc -o build/ring_buffer_test && build/ring_buffer_test && clang++ -std=c++17 -I. tests/pcm_test.cc -o build/pcm_test && build/pcm_test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.js
